description: Implement a priority queue with decrease-key operation
prompt: Write a Python class `MinHeap` with: __init__(self), push(self, key: str, priority: float), pop(self) -> tuple[str, float] (returns and removes min), decrease_key(self, key: str, new_priority: float), peek(self) -> tuple[str, float], __len__(self) -> int. Include test_min_heap() testing: push/pop ordering, decrease_key changes extraction order, empty heap behavior.
expected_behavior: MinHeap maintains correct min-heap ordering, decrease_key updates priority in-place

validation_criteria.l4: test_min_heap() passes: ordering, decrease_key, edge cases
validation_criteria.l5: O(log n) push/pop, decrease_key correctly re-heapifies
